summary: Tested new Dashboard gallery + lightbox feature on /project/:slug pages and ran full backend regression including new digest/weekly email endpoints. All 16 pytest backend tests pass and all frontend lightbox interactions (open, close, prev/next, keyboard Esc/Arrow keys with wrap-around, body scroll lock) work on all three case studies (udaan, retail-intelligence, job-market-analyzer).
critical_code_review_comments: Recharts ResponsiveContainer emits repeated width(-1)/height(-1) warnings on CaseStudy pages initial render. Not blocking (charts eventually render), but consider setting minWidth/minHeight or a fixed aspect on ChartBlock to silence the noise.
Gallery.jsx uses index as React key which is fine for a static gallery array, no action needed.
AnimatePresence + Escape close cleanly restores body.style.overflow to '' — verified via evaluate().
seed_data_creation: Only TEST_ prefixed contact rows created via existing regression tests.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Gallery lightbox on CaseStudy pages verified: thumbnails render with naturalWidth>0, lightbox opens via thumb click, prev/next buttons and ArrowLeft/ArrowRight keys navigate with wrap-around, counter shows N/M, Escape and close button dismiss lightbox and restore body overflow. Backend regression at /app/backend/tests/test_portfolio_api.py now covers digest/weekly send endpoints too — all green.
